Start the Survey Solutions Listing Application on Shiny Server

Source: R/runappserver.R
runListingAppServer.Rd

A wrapper function to start the application on a Shiny Server. Please make sure you have read the documentation on how to use the app at https://datanalytics.worldbank.org/SpatialSamplingManual/.

Usage

runListingAppServer(
  admuser = NULL,
  admpass = NULL,
  provider = c("google", "vantor", "maxar")
)

Arguments

admuser

Character string specifying the admin username (optional).

admpass

Character string specifying the admin password (optional).

provider

Character string specifying the satellite imagery provider: "google" (default, uses googleway and a Google Maps API key) or "vantor" / "maxar" (uses leaflet and vantorr with Vantor/Maxar API credentials).

Value

An object of class shiny.appobj generated by shiny::shinyApp(), ready to be passed to shiny::runApp() or deployed on 'Shiny Server'.

Details

This function is designed for deployment on Shiny Server. Create an app.R script in the server application directory containing:

susolisting::runListingAppServer()

Examples

app <- runListingAppServer()
if (interactive()) {
  shiny::runApp(app)
}
